description: Complete task lifecycle with Running state, timestamps, TaskStarted event, WorkLease elimination, and runner-lost recovery

tasks.title: Add task lifecycle domain model — Running state, timestamps, TaskStarted event, and StageCheck dispatch fields
tasks.description: Add the domain model capabilities for complete task lifecycle: TaskRun gains StartedAt/FinishedAt/RunnerId/WorkId fields and transitions through Running via new StartTask/CompleteTask/FailTask/FailTaskForRunnerLost methods in WorkflowRun.Task.cs. StageCheck gains DispatchWorkId/DispatchRunnerId/DispatchedAt. Add TaskStarted to the WorkflowEvent union and wire it into WorkflowEventSerializer (BusType, FromData, Unwrap). This task is purely additive — WorkflowGrain continues using WorkLease unchanged; the new domain methods are tested directly via unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskRun has nullable StartedAt, FinishedAt (DateTimeOffset?), RunnerId, WorkId (string?) properties
StageCheck has nullable DispatchWorkId, DispatchRunnerId (string?), DispatchedAt (DateTimeOffset?) properties
StartTask(workId, runnerId) transitions Pending→Running, sets StartedAt/WorkId/RunnerId, emits TaskStarted event
CompleteTask() sets FinishedAt before transitioning to Completed
FailTask() sets FinishedAt before transitioning to Failed
FailTaskForRunnerLost() transitions Running→Failed with reason 'runner-lost', sets FinishedAt, emits TaskFailed+StageFailed+WorkflowRunFailed
TaskStarted(Stage, TaskId, RunnerId) is a member of the WorkflowEvent union
WorkflowEventSerializer.BusType maps TaskStarted to EventCatalog.ReverseDns.TaskStarted
WorkflowEventSerializer.FromData and Unwrap handle TaskStarted
Unit tests verify StartTask transition, timestamp population, TaskStarted emission, and FailTaskForRunnerLost event sequence
Unit tests verify StageCheck dispatch metadata set/clear
Existing tests pass; system compiles with WorkflowGrain still using WorkLease
tasks.output: Updated TaskRun.cs, WorkflowRun.Task.cs, StageCheck.cs, WorkflowEvent.cs, WorkflowEventSerializer.cs with domain unit tests under Specs/Workflow/Domain/
tasks.notes: Do NOT remove WorkLease from Shared.cs or modify WorkflowGrain in this task. The domain model is additive and must coexist with the existing WorkLease path so the system stays compilable.

tasks.title: Eliminate WorkLease — WorkflowGrain uses TaskRun as single source of truth for in-flight dispatch
tasks.description: Remove the WorkLease persistent state from WorkflowGrain entirely and rewire all dispatch, result-matching, reactivation-recovery, and read paths to use TaskRun (Status==Running, WorkId, RunnerId) and StageCheck (DispatchWorkId, DispatchRunnerId) fields. RunCoreAsync scans for Running tasks / dispatched checks instead of reading _leaseState. MakeDispatchAsync calls StartTask or sets check dispatch metadata instead of writing the lease. ReportResultAsync matches incoming workId against the Running task's WorkId. GetCurrentWorkIdAsync and GetActiveWorkAsync read from TaskRun/StageCheck. Remove SaveLeaseAsync, ClearAndDeleteLeaseAsync, ClearChecksLeaseAsync, RestoreDispatch. Remove WorkLease record from Shared.cs and the [PersistentState("lease")] constructor parameter.
acceptanceCriteria: No references to _leaseState, WorkLease, SaveLeaseAsync, ClearAndDeleteLeaseAsync, ClearChecksLeaseAsync, or RestoreDispatch remain in WorkflowGrain.cs
WorkLease record is removed from Shared.cs
WorkflowGrain constructor no longer takes [PersistentState("lease")] parameter
RunCoreAsync detects in-flight work by scanning for Running TaskRun or StageCheck with DispatchWorkId set, not by reading a lease
Reactivation recovery: if a Running task's runner is alive, re-assigns via PrepareWorkAsync; if offline, fails as runner-lost
Reactivation recovery: dispatched checks with offline runner are cleared and re-queued
MakeDispatchAsync calls run.StartTask(workId, runnerId) for tasks; sets DispatchWorkId/DispatchRunnerId/DispatchedAt for checks
ReportResultAsync matches incoming workId against Running task's WorkId and RunnerId; unmatched results are ignored
GetCurrentWorkIdAsync returns Running task's WorkId or dispatched check's DispatchWorkId
GetActiveWorkAsync reconstructs WorkflowActiveWorkView from TaskRun/StageCheck state
WorkflowLeaseActivationSpecs updated to verify Running task survives activation instead of lease
Existing HappyPathSpecs, RetryAndRerunSpecs, FeedbackDispatchSpecs, DispatchAndLoadingSpecs, and CheckRetrySpecs pass without modification (or with minimal adaptation to new state model)
Full workflow grain test suite passes
tasks.output: Refactored WorkflowGrain.cs, Shared.cs with updated grain integration tests under Specs/Workflow/Grain/
tasks.notes: This is the highest-risk task — it rewrites the core dispatch/result/recovery flow. WorkLease was a separate Orleans persistent state with its own write path; removing it eliminates the dual-write consistency problem. For task workId: deterministic (= taskRunId), so PrepareWorkAsync regeneration on reactivation produces the same id. For check workId: non-deterministic (Guid-based), so reuse stored DispatchWorkId as override to MakeDispatchAsync. The On(WorkflowEvent) handler needs TaskStarted => EnsureWorkHeartbeatAsync().

tasks.title: Add runner-lost recovery — HandleTimeoutAsync notification and heartbeat safety net
tasks.description: Close the runner-lost gap with two complementary paths. Primary: RunnerGrain.HandleTimeoutAsync (and UnregisterAsync) collect distinct WorkflowRunIds from tracked work and call IWorkflowGrain.NotifyRunnerLostAsync(runnerId) on each before clearing _works and going offline. Safety net: the workflow heartbeat (EnsureWorkHeartbeatAsync) checks RunnerGrain.IsAvailableAsync for each Running task's runner and fails orphans as runner-lost. NotifyRunnerLostAsync scans the current stage for Running tasks with matching RunnerId and fails them via FailTaskForRunnerLost. Notifications are best-effort (try/catch per workflow, log and continue).
acceptanceCriteria: IWorkflowGrain has Task NotifyRunnerLostAsync(string runnerId) method
WorkflowGrain.NotifyRunnerLostAsync fails Running tasks with matching RunnerId as runner-lost; idempotent (no-op if no match)
RunnerGrain.HandleTimeoutAsync notifies each affected WorkflowGrain before clearing _works and going offline
RunnerGrain.UnregisterAsync applies the same notification pattern for graceful shutdown
Notification is scoped to WorkDispatchOwnerKinds.Workflow (AgentJob work excluded per non-goals)
Notification failures are best-effort: one workflow's throw does not block notification to others
Heartbeat safety net: EnsureWorkHeartbeatAsync calls RunnerGrain.IsAvailableAsync for Running tasks; offline runner → task failed as runner-lost
Online runner preserves Running tasks on heartbeat check
Non-running tasks (Pending, Completed, Failed) are not affected by runner-loss notification or heartbeat check
Integration tests verify: runner death → Running task transitions to Failed(runner-lost) via notification path
Integration tests verify: heartbeat safety net catches orphaned Running task when notification is lost
Integration tests verify: partial notification failure does not block other workflows
Existing workflow behavior preserved (dispatch, result, retry, rerun, feedback loop)
tasks.output: Updated IWorkflowGrain.cs, WorkflowGrain.cs (NotifyRunnerLostAsync + heartbeat check), RunnerGrain.cs (HandleTimeoutAsync + UnregisterAsync) with integration tests
tasks.notes: The EventCatalog.ReverseDns.RunnerDisconnected constant already exists for potential future bus-level use, but this task uses direct grain-to-grain calls. The heartbeat mechanism itself (reminder registration, interval) is unchanged — only what it inspects expands to include runner-liveness checks.
